meta.title: DelugeRPG Comprehensive Pokemon Type Chart Database
meta.source: DelugeRPG Official In-Game Battle Engine (Normal Battle)
rules: Attack multiplier is TypeChart(Attack, Def1) * TypeChart(Attack, Def2)
STAB multiplier 1.5x is applied if Attack Type matches ANY of the Attacking Pokemon types
Defensive evaluation accounts for both single and dual types
Negative variant uses pessimistic inverse matchups in regular battles
